text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Good day, I am Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To become a magnificent, graceful, and 
valiant "princess"! I need your help, the 
future "Legendary Trainer"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No problem at a~ll! Any wall that stands 
in my way will be crushed by my 
Princess☆Kick~~!!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
